# @hedystia/cache

> 标签: bun, cache, javascript, node, typescript

## 简介

The Cache class is a generic key-value store that extends the native JavaScript `Map` object, providing additional utility methods for enhanced functionality. This README provides documentation for the Cache class, including method descriptions, parameter
